education.summary: Her campaign site lists education among her priorities and says she wants to put classrooms over tanks and help grow agricultural dominance into the next generation; it does not detail specific proposals.
education.short: Wants to put classrooms over tanks; education a priority.

healthcare.summary: In announcing her campaign, she said it will focus on protecting human rights and dignity and defending the progress made as a nation in health care, individual liberty, and prosperity; she did not detail specific health care proposals.
healthcare.short: Says campaign will defend progress made in health care.

economy.summary: His campaign says he backs workers and small businesses and pledges to bring fiscal responsibility to state government.
economy.short: Backs workers, small businesses; pledges fiscal responsibility.

taxes.summary: Voted for the $50.8 billion 2026-27 state budget, calling it a fair deal for the Commonwealth and noting that it does not take any money out of the state's Rainy Day Fund.
taxes.short: Voted for 2026-27 budget; says it preserves Rainy Day Fund.

abortion.summary: His campaign site lists defending pro-life values among his commitments; it does not detail specific abortion legislation.
abortion.short: Campaign site pledges to defend pro-life values.

education.summary: Supported the 2025-26 state budget's doubling of scholarship funding for students in underperforming schools and its protection of cyber charter school funding, saying it keeps education flexible and centered on students.
education.short: Supports scholarship expansion and cyber charter funding protection.

healthcare.summary: His health-related statements have centered on emergency medical services rather than broader health care policy: after a 2025 state audit found mismanaged EMS funding, he said the Department of Health must be held accountable for dollars meant for training, staffing, equipment and patient care.
healthcare.short: On EMS, demands Health Department accountability for mismanaged funding.

energy.summary: Supported the 2025-26 state budget's withdrawal of Pennsylvania from the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative, calling RGGI a tax on consumers and saying exiting it removes a barrier to economic growth.
energy.short: Supports RGGI withdrawal; calls it a tax on consumers.

guns.summary: His campaign site says he will defend Second Amendment values and pledges to fight to improve public safety for residents of Northumberland and Montour counties, citing his background as a firefighter and EMT.
guns.short: Defends Second Amendment values; pledges to improve public safety.
